description: Find in the chat: a bar that slides in at the top of the chat column (under any banner, over the transcript) while searching, which shades every match in the chat's text. The same bar serves Meta's chat, a side question and a subagent's transcript, each over its own text.

parts.name: search box
parts.shows: A search field, filling the bar, with the placeholder "Find in chat". Opens with the one-line text selected in the chat (if any) already typed in, and focused with its text selected.

actions.does: Finds every match as typed, case ignored, in the chat's text (up to 2000), the current one brought into view; matches shaded, the current one more strongly. A reply still arriving is searched again when stepping
Closes the bar, drops the shading and puts the focus back where it was

parts.name: count
parts.shows: A small dim label right of the box, right-aligned: "3 of 12"; "3 of 12+" while parts of a long chat are not drawn yet; "No matches"; "⏎ earlier" when the drawn text has no match but earlier, undrawn parts might (Enter then looks through the chat's saved transcript, draws the nearest part that has the text and goes to the match); "searching…" while that look runs. Empty with nothing typed.

parts.name: previous and next buttons
parts.shows: Two flat icon buttons, an up arrow and a down arrow.

actions.does: Steps to the previous or next match

parts.name: close button
parts.shows: A × at the right end of the bar.

actions.does: Closes the bar as Esc does

parts.name: what is searched
parts.shows: The chat's visible text (messages, tool cards that are open); text inside closed tool cards or revealers is not. Matches in a code block's own scroller are scrolled into view too. Ctrl+F goes to the find bar of the thing the focus is in (Kubernetes' or a code page's find, a side question, a subagent, Meta) before the main chat's.

states.name: closed
states.shows: No bar, no width or height taken

decisions.said: Ctrl/Cmd+F should search the main chat, Meta and side questions alike, with highlighting and next/previous
decisions.rule: Every app's agent conversations (the chat, Meta, a side question, a subagent's transcript) open the same find bar on Ctrl+F / ⌘F, shading matches and stepping between them.
